description: Migrate a Windows Server instance to a new instance at a higher OS version with full inventory transfer, data sync via robocopy, EIP/DNS/ENI cutover, and 24-hour rollback window.

source_asset_id.label: Source Asset ID
source_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the source Windows Server instance currently serving traffic

dest_asset_id.label: Dest Asset ID
dest_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the new Windows Server instance at the target OS version

cutover_method.label: Cutover Method
cutover_method.description: Traffic swap method: eip | dns | eni

cutover_config.label: Cutover Config
cutover_config.description: Method-specific config: {eip_allocation_id} for eip; {hosted_zone_id, record_name, ttl} for dns; {eni_id} for eni

registry_keys.label: Registry Keys
registry_keys.description: Additional HKLM registry key paths to include in inventory scan, e.g. ["HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\MyApp"]

hostname_replacements.label: Hostname Replacements
hostname_replacements.description: List of hostname string replacements to apply on dest after sync, e.g. [{"location": "file", "path": "C:\\app\\config.ini", "old": "old-host", "new": "new-host"}]

decommission_after_hours.label: Decommission After Hours
decommission_after_hours.description: Hours to wait before terminating source (0 = manual only, default 24)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, run preflight + inventory only, no sync or cutover

rollback.description: Reverse cutover (re-associate EIP / restore DNS / re-attach ENI), start source, verify agent responds within 300s
